content: Portions of our resource have been used in early efforts to build language systems for Mapudungun. In particular, BIBREF22 focused on Mapudungun morphology in order to create spelling correction systems, while BIBREF23, BIBREF6, BIBREF24, and BIBREF25 developed hybrid rule- and phrase-based Statistical Machine Translation systems.
